start: Phone app on a main tab, a Wear OS watch connected with an older MettleUp watch app, no Later stored, no phone update waiting

user_sees: Pop-up 'Your watch app has an update'
Kicker 'New version: <phone version>'
'New on your watch:' with up to 3 watch lines, or 'Update it so your watch and phone work well together.'
Buttons 'Update on watch' and 'Later'
must_not: The pop-up over an open workout
Two pop-ups on top of each other

user_sees: 'Check your watch'
'Look at your watch and tap Update there. If its screen is dark, tap it first.'
'Got it' and 'Nothing on your watch? Try again'
must_not: A message that the update is done before the watch even opened Play Store
A spinner for longer than about 20 seconds

steps.action: Tap 'Got it', close and reopen the app the next day on the same phone version
user_sees: The pop-up closes
No watch pop-up again for this phone version
must_not: The same pop-up every day for a watch the member already tried to update

start: Older watch app, but the watch is out of Bluetooth reach when the app opens

steps.action: Open the app while the watch is away
user_sees: No watch pop-up
must_not: A pop-up whose only button can say 'Your watch is not connected'

steps.action: Bring the watch back in reach within about half an hour, or come back to the app after 6+ hours
user_sees: 'Your watch app has an update' once the watch is connected
must_not: No pop-up ever once the watch is back
The pop-up while a workout is open

start: Pop-up showing; the watch loses its connection or Play Store on the watch cannot be opened

steps.action: Tap 'Update on watch' with Bluetooth off
user_sees: 'Your watch is not connected'
'Check that Bluetooth is on, then tap Try again. Or open Play Store on your watch, search for MettleUp and tap Update.'
'Try again'
must_not: 'Check your watch' when nothing was sent to the watch

steps.action: Tap 'Update on watch' when the watch answers with an error
user_sees: 'The update did not start'
'Open Play Store on your watch, search for MettleUp and tap Update.'
must_not: A crash or an endless spinner
A message that says the update failed for good

start: Pop-up showing for phone version A

user_sees: The pop-up closes
must_not: The pop-up back on the next app open within 24 hours

steps.action: Open the app again a day later
user_sees: The pop-up again
must_not: Never asked again after one Later

steps.action: Update the phone app to a newer version and open it
user_sees: The pop-up at once, with the new version in the kicker
must_not: The old 24-hour Later still holding back the new version

steps.action: With the watch updated to the phone's version, open the app
user_sees: No pop-up
must_not: The pop-up for a watch that is already up to date

steps.action: Look at what the check uses and where it shows
user_sees: Only the watch's app version is compared
No phone notification about the watch update
must_not: The watch's name or id in the shared watch log line
An extra phone notification on top of Play's own
